records.decision: A deadline for additional changes to the data will be set.
rationale: To prevent open-ended changes and to make the data available to other researchers.
conditions: The exact length of time for the deadline is yet to be decided.
dissent: Postdoc A suggested a specific date (July 15th) but the group is considering a longer period.
